name: Thousand Islands National Park
policyReason: Leashed dogs can hike the trails and stay at 61 pet-friendly island campsites.
summary: Leashed dogs can hike the trails and stay at 61 pet-friendly island campsites.

excerpts.quote: Got your own boat? Then set sail on an island adventure and stay at one of 61 pet-friendly campsites across the park’s 20 islands.
Keeping your dog on a leash protects both your dog and any other animal that you may encounter.

dogRules.text: Pet-friendly oTENTiks 3B and 3E at Mallorytown Landing; 61 pet-friendly island campsites.
Ticks are common; check yourself and pets.
